metadata.note: 1991–2020 normals, but the window is shorter at stations relocated during the period — see yukiHatsu_from/_to per feature. There is no then-vs-now shift for 雪 the way there is for 桜 and 梅雨: this archive publishes one normals window, not a per-year series. 昭和 (Syowa, Antarctica) is in JMA's surface network and is excluded.
